tasks.short: Get financial transactions into AFAS and keep the records complete.

today.trigger: Invoices, receipts, bank transactions or agency files arrive and need recording; this workflow is inferred from the company description.
steps: Collect documents from Outlook, SharePoint and agency portals.
Find the supplier or customer and check that the transaction is not already recorded.
Enter or import the transaction into AFAS using the agreed coding.
Attach the source document and resolve rejected entries.
Check that the batch is complete and available for reporting.
drudgery: Downloading files and attaching the same documents again
Copying references and amounts between systems
Checking whether an import succeeded
today.time_sinks: Switching between three agency portals, inconsistent file layouts and investigating incomplete imports.

lenses.faster: Import structured transactions once, attach their evidence automatically and return only rejected items. Repeated downloading, typing and checking import screens disappear.
lenses.autonomous: An arriving file or scheduled portal export starts ingestion, completeness checks and posting of eligible transactions. Missing files and rejected records create exceptions for the bookkeeper.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain a daily view of unrecorded invoices and missing agency costs across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo. Give the Controller earlier evidence for accruals and the forecast.
lenses.joy: Remove file handling and rekeying. Leave the bookkeeper with resolving unusual transactions and helping colleagues supply better evidence.
lenses.options: Compare native AFAS imports, supported connectors and a small integration service. Choose by reliability, support effort and cost per accepted transaction.
lenses.altitude: Own the transaction intake rules, completeness controls and exception queue. Improve the system using rejection rates and recurring supplier problems.
reach: Prepare missing-invoice evidence for the Accountant's accruals
Maintain supplier document requirements with procurement
Supply daily transaction-completeness measures to the Controller

tasks.human_edge: Recognising when a technically valid entry misrepresents the business event, and obtaining reliable evidence from the right colleague.
tasks.pattern_why: File intake, duplicate protection, imports and completeness checks have explicit rules and checkable results. Add an llm_step only for documents that lack structured fields; coding and validation are separate controls covered below.

in_practice.trigger: A document arrives in the finance mailbox or an agreed agency export becomes available.
steps: Register the source file with a unique identifier and check that the expected delivery is complete.
Read structured fields directly; extract unstructured fields into a fixed schema and retain document references.
Apply duplicate, master-data and required-field checks, using approved coding and validation rules.
Post eligible records through a tested AFAS import or supported connector and capture the returned identifiers.
Reconcile submitted counts and totals to accepted records; route failures without blindly resubmitting the batch.
in_practice.human_gate: The bookkeeper resolves uncertain documents and failed imports. New suppliers, bank-detail changes and unusual journals follow separate approval controls.
systems: AFAS Profit imports or supported connectors
Agency exports or supported portal integrations
data_needed: Representative documents and exports from all three agencies
Required transaction fields and approved coding
Expected file schedules and batch control totals
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS transaction references and a restricted SharePoint intake register containing source identifiers, totals, failures and resolutions.

evidence.claim: AFAS supports external record operations through UpdateConnectors and imports; supported operations vary by connector.
The proposed intake workflow and estimates of 70% less human handling and 3 times faster completion are planning assumptions, not measured Noordhaven results.

risks: A retry creates duplicate entries unless source identifiers and posting acknowledgements are reconciled.
Agency portal access or export formats may not support reliable unattended collection.
An integration account could inherit unnecessary HR access because finance and HR share AFAS.
Automatically recording incomplete evidence can move errors into month close.
research_questions: What proportion of incoming transactions already arrives in structured formats, by source?
Which required AFAS financial operations and document attachments are supported in Noordhaven's configuration?
Can each agency provide stable exports with identifiers, counts and totals?
Does a representative pilot reduce handling time without increasing duplicates or missing records?

tasks.short: Check invoice figures, postings and codes before errors reach the ledger.

today.trigger: A transaction is ready to post, an import finishes or a month-close check identifies a possible error.
steps: Open the invoice or other evidence alongside the AFAS entry.
Recalculate totals and compare dates, references and amounts.
Check supplier, customer, VAT, ledger and site codes.
Compare agency charges with approved hours and agreed rates where available.
Correct the entry or ask the responsible colleague for clarification.
drudgery: Rechecking arithmetic already available electronically
Comparing long lists line by line
Repeating the same VAT and coding checks
today.time_sinks: Finding the evidence behind a mismatch and distinguishing real errors from timing or rounding differences.

lenses.faster: Run arithmetic, duplicate, reference and permitted-code checks on every transaction. Show the failed rule beside the relevant source line so the bookkeeper investigates only the difference.
lenses.autonomous: Each proposed posting runs through the control rules before release. Clear failures are held, while eligible transactions continue under an approved policy.
lenses.ambitious: Check all agency invoice lines against approved hours and effective rates, including shift premiums where the agreements require them. Identify recurring overcharges before they become monthly disputes.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive ticking and recalculation. Keep the investigation that explains why a charge is wrong and prevents it happening again.
lenses.options: Show whether a discrepancy is consistent with rounding, a wrong rate, missing hours or a duplicate. Present evidence for each explanation without choosing an unsupported correction.
lenses.altitude: Maintain a control catalogue with owners, tolerances and evidence requirements. Measure escaped errors as well as the number of exceptions raised.
reach: Prepare control evidence for the Accountant
Analyse agency billing errors with HR Administration and procurement
Provide the Controller with recurring error and rework trends

tasks.human_edge: Judging whether the underlying service, hours or commercial agreement supports the charge, especially when the documents disagree.
tasks.pattern_why: Arithmetic, permitted codes, rate comparisons and duplicate checks can be expressed as rules. Models may help locate evidence, but should not calculate totals or decide whether a control passed.

in_practice.trigger: A draft entry is created or changed, with a daily scan for items that bypassed intake.
steps: Read the proposed entry, source document fields and applicable master data.
Recalculate amounts and test references, duplicate indicators, VAT combinations and permitted site codes.
For agency invoices, compare line items with approved hours and effective, authorised rates.
Hold failed items with the exact difference and supporting evidence; pass eligible items under the approved rules.
Record resolutions and review a sample of passed items for errors the rules missed.
in_practice.human_gate: The bookkeeper resolves failures; the Accountant approves accounting-policy exceptions. HR or Payroll confirms disputed CAO-related rate inputs rather than the system interpreting the CAO itself.
data_needed: Approved agency hours and contracted rates with effective dates
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted SharePoint control register linked to AFAS entries, recording rule versions, results, overrides and approvers.

evidence.claim: AFAS GetConnectors allow an administrator to define which records and fields an integration retrieves.
The cross-source validation rules and estimates of 75% less human handling and 3.5 times faster completion need testing on Noordhaven's actual error mix.

risks: A wrong master-data rule can pass the same error across thousands of entries.
Incomplete hours or outdated rate tables create misleading agency exceptions.
Broad tolerances hide errors, while narrow tolerances overwhelm the bookkeepers.
Matching agency hours exposes worker information; use only necessary fields and restrict access.
research_questions: Which historical errors would explicit rules have caught, and which required business judgement?
Are approved hours and effective agency rates available at invoice-line level?
What exception volume results from testing candidate tolerances on a full month?
Who can authorise a rule change or override, and can those decisions be traced?

tasks.short: Assign the right ledger, VAT, site and cost-centre codes to each document.

today.trigger: A new invoice, credit note or other document needs accounting codes.
steps: Read the document and identify the supplier, service and accounting period.
Look up the chart of accounts, coding guidance and similar earlier entries.
Choose ledger, VAT, site and cost-centre codes and any required split.
Ask the site owner or Accountant about unclear allocations.
Enter the codes in AFAS and retain the supporting explanation.
drudgery: Looking up the same supplier treatment repeatedly
Searching old invoices for a coding precedent
Splitting recurring invoices across sites
today.time_sinks: Ambiguous descriptions, invoices covering several sites and deciding whether earlier coding was actually correct.

lenses.faster: Apply approved mappings to recurring documents and suggest codes for unfamiliar descriptions. Put the relevant policy and source wording beside each suggestion.
lenses.autonomous: Documents matching a narrow, approved rule receive codes automatically. New services, conflicting evidence and unusual allocations go to review.
lenses.ambitious: Code agency and supplier costs consistently by site, service period and agreed cost category. Give FP&A more useful cost detail without adding manual entry.
lenses.joy: Remove code hunting and repeated allocations. Keep the work of understanding unusual spend and making guidance clearer.
lenses.options: For ambiguous items, show up to three valid coding alternatives and their effects on site costs or period treatment. Explain what additional fact would settle the choice.
lenses.altitude: Own a versioned coding guide and monitor which rules cause corrections. Convert repeated human decisions into approved mappings.
reach: Improve cost-category definitions with FP&A
Maintain supplier coding mappings with the Accountant
Help site managers understand allocation evidence requirements

tasks.human_edge: Understanding the substance of the purchase, fair allocation between sites and when an accounting-policy judgement belongs with the Accountant.
tasks.pattern_why: Unstructured descriptions can be converted into constrained coding suggestions. Deterministic rules enforce valid codes, while uncertain accounting interpretations remain gated; the lower earlier gain score warrants a conservative rollout.

in_practice.trigger: An uncoded document enters the finance intake queue.
steps: Read document text and retrieve the applicable coding guide and approved supplier mappings.
Apply exact mappings first; otherwise generate a structured suggestion with source references and missing facts.
Validate codes, permitted combinations, allocation totals and accounting-period constraints.
Ask the bookkeeper to approve or amend the proposed coding before it is used.
Record the decision and propose recurring mappings for separate Accountant approval.
in_practice.human_gate: The bookkeeper approves each model-generated coding proposal. The Accountant decides new policy treatments, capitalisation questions and material allocation exceptions.
systems: Proposed document extraction and coding service
data_needed: Current chart of accounts and permitted code combinations
Site allocation rules and effective dates
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted SharePoint coding decision register linked to the AFAS document, with policy version, proposal, final codes and reviewer.

evidence.claim: A language model can plausibly suggest constrained accounting codes from document descriptions, but Noordhaven's coding accuracy is untested.
Estimates of 55% less human handling and 2 times faster completion assume recurring invoices are common and human review remains necessary.

risks: Historical coding may contain errors that the model repeats.
A plausible explanation can conceal an incorrect VAT or capitalisation treatment.
Supplier-level defaults can miscode suppliers that provide several different services.
Invoice text can contain misleading instructions; treat it as evidence, never as workflow instructions.
research_questions: What share of documents fits an unambiguous, approved recurring mapping?
How accurately do suggestions match an Accountant-reviewed sample across all three sites?
Does reviewing a suggestion take less time than coding the document directly?
Which coding errors have sufficient financial impact to require mandatory specialist review?

tasks.short: Calculate amounts due, discounts, interest and balances from agreed terms.

today.trigger: An invoice, payment proposal, balance query or loan schedule requires a calculation.
steps: Find the principal amount, relevant dates and agreed terms.
Select or adapt an Excel calculation.
Calculate the balance, discount, interest or repayment split.
Check rounding, day-count conventions and agreement with AFAS.
Save the calculation and pass the result to the relevant workflow.
drudgery: Re-entering amounts and dates
Copying formulas between workbooks
Rechecking rounding and formula references
today.time_sinks: Finding the authoritative terms and checking whether an old workbook uses the right assumptions.

lenses.faster: Use one tested calculation service fed by AFAS balances and approved terms. Manual formula construction and repeated arithmetic checks disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A changed balance or due date recalculates eligible amounts automatically. Missing terms, disputed principal and unusual contracts stop the calculation for review.
lenses.ambitious: Calculate discount opportunities and expected balances for all eligible invoices each day. Give the Controller a complete view of potential savings and financing costs.
lenses.joy: Remove spreadsheet copying and fear of broken formulas. Keep explaining exceptions and helping colleagues understand the financial effect of terms.
lenses.options: Compare payment on the due date, early payment with discount and an approved alternative date. Show cash use and financing cost under the same assumptions.
lenses.altitude: Maintain the approved formulas, term sources and regression examples. Monitor changes in agreements rather than rebuild calculations.
reach: Prepare financing-cost schedules for the Accountant
Provide payment-timing scenarios to the Controller
Support the Credit and Collections Officer with evidenced balance calculations

tasks.human_edge: Determining which terms actually govern a disputed or unusual transaction, and whether a calculated charge should be pursued.
tasks.pattern_why: Approved formulas, dates and amounts produce reproducible results. AI can help build and document the calculator, but a language model should not perform the production arithmetic.

in_practice.trigger: A balance changes, a scheduled calculation date arrives or a user requests a supported calculation.
steps: Retrieve the current amount and approved, effective terms.
Validate currency, dates, rate basis, day-count convention and rounding method.
Run versioned decimal calculations and compare totals with the source balance.
Return the result with an input and formula breakdown; hold unsupported cases.
Attach the calculation to the invoice, account or proposed journal without automatically issuing a charge.
in_practice.human_gate: The Accountant approves new calculation methods and contractual interpretations. The Credit and Collections Officer approves pursuing interest charges, and authorised staff approve resulting postings or payments.
systems: Proposed deterministic calculation service or controlled Excel model
data_needed: Current principal amounts and transaction dates
Known examples independently checked by the Accountant
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted SharePoint calculation register linked to AFAS, retaining inputs, term references, formula version and results.

evidence.claim: Financial arithmetic with explicit formulas and validated inputs is suitable for deterministic automation without a production language model.
Estimates of 80% less human handling and 4 times faster completion assume authoritative terms are available; gathering disputed terms remains manual.

risks: A correct formula applied to the wrong contractual terms gives a wrong result.
Day-count, rounding or effective-date differences accumulate across many accounts.
A calculated interest amount could be mistaken for an approved customer charge.
Unusual equity or financing calculations may exceed the bookkeeper's remit and need the Accountant.
research_questions: Which calculation types actually occur, and how much time does each consume?
Are contractual terms stored consistently with effective dates and named owners?
Can the calculator reproduce independently verified examples, including partial payments and period boundaries?
Do discount scenarios remain attractive after financing cost and payment-processing constraints?

tasks.short: Prepare AFAS payment batches for utilities, taxes and other approved bills.

today.trigger: A payment run is due or a utility bill, tax assessment or other approved obligation approaches its deadline; SEPA batches replace the O*NET reference to checks.
steps: Collect due, approved items from AFAS and check special payment instructions.
Confirm amounts, references, payment blocks and verified beneficiary details.
Prepare the payment proposal and identify urgent or unusual items.
Obtain approval from the authorised budget or finance owner.
Prepare or upload the Rabobank batch for authorised release and later reconciliation.
drudgery: Building the due-items list repeatedly
Checking routine payment references
Chasing approvals and comparing batch totals
today.time_sinks: Last-minute approvals, changed beneficiary details, blocked invoices and confirming whether a batch was already submitted.

lenses.faster: Generate a payment proposal with evidence, exceptions and totals already assembled. The bookkeeper reviews a complete pack instead of rebuilding it.
lenses.autonomous: A scheduled run prepares eligible items and routes the proposal for approval. Actual bank release remains with authorised signatories.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain a forward payment calendar covering regular suppliers, agency peaks and tax deadlines. Give the Controller an earlier view of committed cash outflows.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive batch preparation and approval chasing. Keep solving urgent supplier problems and making payment timing understandable.
lenses.options: Compare due-date payment, early-payment discounts and a cash-constrained proposal. Clearly identify anything that would require agreement with a supplier.
lenses.altitude: Own the readiness and control quality of payment proposals. Improve approval lead times, exception causes and the match between approved and submitted batches.
reach: Prepare committed-cash inputs for the Controller
Maintain the operational payment calendar
Coordinate payment evidence for the Accountant and audit

tasks.human_edge: Recognising fraud indicators, resolving competing cash priorities and accepting responsibility for an authorised payment decision.
tasks.pattern_why: Preparing a batch involves several systems, supporting documents and exceptions. Deterministic selection and totals support the workflow, while people approve the exact batch and retain bank authority.

in_practice.trigger: The scheduled payment-run cutoff arrives or an authorised urgent-payment request is registered.
steps: Retrieve due, approved obligations and reconcile them with payment blocks and previously submitted batches.
Validate amounts, tax references and beneficiary details against controlled records; hold new or changed bank details.
Create the proposed batch, item-level evidence and a cash-impact summary.
Route the exact proposal for approval and invalidate that approval if an item changes.
Prepare the approved file for the authorised Rabobank process and record its identifier and totals.
Track bank acknowledgement and reconcile execution before marking items paid.
in_practice.human_gate: The bookkeeper reviews the proposal; authorised finance staff approve it and bank signatories release it under Noordhaven's mandate. Beneficiary changes require independent verification through a trusted channel.
systems: Optional Power Automate approval workflow, subject to licensing and configuration
data_needed: Approved open items, due dates and payment blocks
Verified beneficiary master data and change history
Tax assessments and required payment references
Cash constraints and earlier batch status
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS payment records, Rabobank acknowledgements and a restricted approval register retaining the exact approved batch identifier, totals and sign-offs.

evidence.claim: Power Automate supports workflows that wait for an approval response before subsequent actions proceed.
The AFAS-to-Rabobank preparation design and estimates of 45% less human handling and 1.5 times faster completion require local verification; approval and bank timing remain constraints.

risks: Fraudulent beneficiary changes can turn an accurate batch into a loss.
The file submitted to the bank may differ from the approved proposal.
A retry or uncertain bank acknowledgement can cause duplicate submission.
Combining preparation, master-data changes and release permissions weakens separation of duties.
research_questions: Which payment preparation and approval steps are already automated in AFAS and Rabobank?
Can the approved batch be reliably tied to the exact file and items submitted?
How are duplicate submissions, rejected payments and uncertain acknowledgements handled today?
How much elapsed time is preparation versus waiting for approvals or bank processing?

tasks.short: Reconcile AFAS records with bank statements, agency schedules and Excel journals.

today.trigger: A bank statement, agency schedule or month-close workbook is ready to compare with AFAS; digital schedules replace the O*NET printouts and manual journals where possible.
steps: Export the AFAS records and obtain the corresponding external schedule or Excel journal.
Align dates, references, signs and reporting periods.
Match entries and compare opening balances, movements and closing balances.
Investigate unmatched items, timing differences and duplicates.
Document the reconciliation and submit proposed corrections for review.
drudgery: Formatting exports into comparable columns
Using repeated lookups and colour-coded ticks
Carrying unresolved differences into another workbook
today.time_sinks: Missing references, partial settlements, inconsistent cutoff dates and repeatedly investigating the same unmatched items.

lenses.faster: Normalise the two sources, match exact references and calculate control totals automatically. Give the bookkeeper a short list of differences with their history.
lenses.autonomous: A new source file starts a reconciliation and updates outstanding exceptions. Only defined exact matches clear automatically.
lenses.ambitious: Reconcile key accounts daily and identify agency liabilities before month close. Retire duplicate Excel journals where AFAS can hold the authoritative record.
lenses.joy: Remove line-by-line ticking and workbook repair. Keep the investigation that establishes where money or evidence is missing.
lenses.options: Show candidate explanations such as partial payment, combined settlement or cutoff timing. Keep candidates separate from confirmed matches.
lenses.altitude: Own reconciliation coverage, matching rules and the age of unresolved differences. Improve the source processes that repeatedly generate breaks.
reach: Prepare balance-sheet reconciliation packs for the Accountant
Maintain close-readiness indicators for the Controller
Coordinate agency statement discrepancies with procurement

tasks.human_edge: Establishing whether a difference reflects a real missing transaction, a timing issue or unreliable evidence, and deciding the appropriate correction.
tasks.pattern_why: Normalisation, control totals and exact matching are rule-based and reproducible. Ambiguous combinations remain suggestions requiring human confirmation.

in_practice.trigger: Both sources for an account and period are available, with a separate alert if either source is late.
steps: Capture dated source snapshots and validate completeness, opening balances and movement totals.
Normalise identifiers, signs, currencies and cutoff dates without altering source evidence.
Apply approved exact and grouped matching rules, preventing reuse of the same transaction.
Produce unmatched items and candidate explanations with evidence and ageing.
Route corrections for approval and retain the reconciliation with reviewer sign-off where required.
in_practice.human_gate: The bookkeeper confirms ambiguous matches. The Accountant approves adjusting journals and required month-close reconciliation sign-offs.
systems: Rabobank statement files or configured bank connection
Controlled Excel or proposed reconciliation service
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted SharePoint reconciliation archive with source snapshots, rule versions, matched identifiers, differences and approvals; corrections link back to AFAS.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit can import electronic bank statements and automatically match recognised lines to open items or ledger accounts when configured.
Extending reconciliation to agency schedules and Excel journals, with 75% less human handling and 3.5 times faster completion, is a local design estimate.

risks: Two incomplete sources can agree and create false confidence.
Loose matching rules can hide duplicates or unrelated transactions.
Changing source files without snapshots makes later reconstruction difficult.
A reconciled difference may still need an approved accounting correction.
research_questions: Which reconciliations remain manual, and which duplicate existing AFAS bank matching?
Do both sources provide complete populations and independent control totals?
What share of items matches exactly without ambiguous many-to-many combinations?
Does daily reconciliation reduce unresolved close items and subsequent audit adjustments?

tasks.short: Answer invoice, payment and account-balance questions with the supporting records.

today.trigger: A colleague, supplier or customer asks about an invoice, payment or account balance.
steps: Identify the requester, account and question.
Search AFAS for invoices, open items and payment records.
Find supporting documents or correspondence in SharePoint and Outlook.
Check whether the answer needs fresher data than the nightly Power BI extract.
Explain the status and pass disputes or commitments to the responsible colleague.
drudgery: Searching several systems for one invoice
Answering repeated payment-status questions
Copying balances and references into emails
today.time_sinks: Incomplete references, checking who may see the account and resolving differences between current AFAS data and yesterday's dashboard.

lenses.faster: Retrieve the account record and supporting evidence in one permission-checked search. Draft a short answer with document links and a clear data timestamp.
lenses.autonomous: An authenticated internal request can receive a standard, factual answer when the account and evidence are unambiguous. External replies and disputed interpretations remain drafts.
lenses.ambitious: Offer site managers self-service answers about approved finance records and recurring queries. Analyse question themes to improve invoice visibility and supplier instructions.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive searching and copying. Leave the bookkeeper to explain unusual situations and resolve problems that matter to the requester.
lenses.options: Present a brief status answer or a detailed transaction breakdown for the same evidence. Offer possible clarification questions when the account is unclear.
lenses.altitude: Own the answer catalogue, access rules and evidence quality. Monitor incorrect answers, unanswered questions and sources that become stale.
reach: Provide routine internal finance helpdesk support
Prepare account histories for the Credit and Collections Officer
Identify recurring reporting needs for FP&A

tasks.human_edge: Understanding what the requester actually needs, handling a sensitive dispute and deciding what the company can responsibly promise.
tasks.pattern_why: Answering requires permission checks, retrieval across sources and a grounded explanation. Standard internal facts can be returned conditionally; external communication and judgement require review.

in_practice.trigger: A question enters the designated Teams channel or finance mailbox.
steps: Authenticate the requester and establish the account and permitted scope before retrieval.
Retrieve current AFAS facts and authorised supporting documents through constrained searches.
Reconcile conflicting evidence and label the source timestamp, including Power BI's nightly refresh.
Draft an answer containing only supported facts, references and any unresolved uncertainty.
Route the answer to the bookkeeper for review and send only through the authorised channel.
in_practice.human_gate: The bookkeeper approves replies during the initial rollout and all external replies thereafter. Payment promises, disputes and credit decisions go to the relevant authorised owner.
data_needed: Current invoice, payment and open-item records
Approved response templates and escalation owners
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted finance request register with requester, source identifiers, data timestamp, answer, reviewer and outcome; avoid duplicating unnecessary personal data.

evidence.claim: AFAS GetConnectors provide configurable retrieval of records and fields, enabling a controlled finance data source.
Permission-aware retrieval and drafted answers could reduce human handling by 60% and halve completion time; answer quality and access enforcement need a pilot.

risks: An assistant may reveal another supplier's, customer's or employee's information if retrieval permissions are too broad.
A payment proposal can be misreported as an executed payment.
Nightly Power BI data may miss a payment or correction made today.
A fluent answer may introduce an unsupported payment date or commitment.
research_questions: What share of questions is factual and repeatable rather than disputed or judgement-based?
Can account-level access be enforced before retrieval rather than only in the final answer?
Can users reliably distinguish planned, submitted, executed and reconciled payments?
Does a reviewed pilot improve response time while maintaining correct balances, references and disclosure boundaries?

tasks.short: Track overdue receivables and upcoming loan payments, and flag exceptions.

today.trigger: The daily account review is due, a payment deadline passes or a bank receipt changes an account balance.
steps: Open AFAS ageing reports and the approved loan repayment schedule.
Compare due amounts with bank receipts, payments and open items.
Identify overdue, partial, unmatched or disputed amounts.
Update the monitoring list and notify the Credit and Collections Officer or Controller.
Follow up unresolved exceptions and record the latest status.
drudgery: Rebuilding ageing lists
Checking the same accounts without new activity
Updating separate follow-up spreadsheets
today.time_sinks: Separating genuinely overdue accounts from unmatched receipts, disputes, payment arrangements and stale reporting.

lenses.faster: Combine due dates, current open items and reconciled bank movements into one exception list. Repeated account checking and spreadsheet updates disappear.
lenses.autonomous: Daily checks and new bank movements update account status and create internal alerts under approved thresholds. The bookkeeper handles unresolved matches and missing evidence.
lenses.ambitious: Track disputes, payment arrangements and approaching loan deadlines in one shared view. Give Collections and the Controller earlier warnings about cash shortfalls.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive monitoring of accounts that have not changed. Keep investigating unexplained balances and helping colleagues resolve the cause.
lenses.options: Show queues ordered by overdue value, age or broken payment arrangement. Compare cash expectations using contracted dates and separately labelled collection assumptions.
lenses.altitude: Own the reliability of account status and exception routing. Improve unmatched-cash ageing and the speed at which genuine collection issues reach their owner.
reach: Prepare prioritised worklists for the Credit and Collections Officer
Maintain operational debt-service calendars for the Controller
Supply evidence-based receipts assumptions to FP&A

tasks.human_edge: Knowing when a late payment signals a dispute or relationship problem, and distinguishing bookkeeping evidence from a decision to change credit or financing terms.
tasks.pattern_why: Due-date comparisons, payment-status updates and internal threshold alerts use structured data and explicit rules. Collection negotiations and changes to loan or credit terms remain human decisions.

in_practice.trigger: A daily monitoring run starts or a processed bank movement changes an account.
steps: Retrieve current AFAS open items, approved repayment schedules and the latest bank-processing status.
Match receipts and payments using approved rules, keeping ambiguous movements unresolved.
Calculate days overdue and distinguish disputes, arrangements, partial payments and missing bank data.
Update the shared exception queue and notify the assigned internal owner only when a threshold or status changes.
Record resolutions and provide timestamped totals to the nightly Power BI reporting process.
in_practice.human_gate: The bookkeeper resolves ambiguous status. Collections approves customer contact and arrangements; the Controller owns loan escalation, and authorised finance staff approve credit holds, write-offs or changed terms.
systems: Rabobank statements or configured bank connection
Restricted SharePoint repayment and exception registers
data_needed: Current open items, due dates and payment references
Bank statement completeness and processing timestamps
Internal alert thresholds and named owners
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS account references and a restricted exception register recording status changes, evidence timestamps, alerts, owners and resolutions.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit supports matching recognised bank statement lines to debtor and creditor open items, providing a native foundation for account-status monitoring.
The combined loan and account exception workflow, with 65% less human handling and 2.5 times faster completion, is a planning estimate rather than a documented deployment.

risks: Unprocessed bank data can make a paid account appear overdue.
Unmatched or partial receipts can incorrectly clear an account.
Outdated loan amendments produce incorrect deadlines or amounts.
Too many alerts obscure genuine exceptions and duplicate Collections' work.
research_questions: How quickly are Rabobank movements processed into reliable AFAS account status?
Are loan schedules, amendments, disputes and payment arrangements maintained in accessible structured records?
Which alerts lead to useful action, and which duplicate the Collections Officer's existing workflow?
Does the pilot reduce monitoring effort and unmatched-cash ageing without creating false overdue alerts?

role.altitude: The bookkeeper becomes the owner of reliable transaction flow: complete records, consistent coding, effective controls and resolved exceptions before month close.
reach: Prepare reconciliation and accrual evidence for the Accountants
Supply committed-payment and expected-receipt inputs to the Controller and FP&A
Prepare prioritised, evidenced account exceptions for the Credit and Collections Officer
Maintain agency billing checks with HR Administration, Payroll and procurement using approved hours and rates
Own operational finance data quality and recurring supplier-error analysis
role.ceiling_note: The eight tasks total 583.6 hours per FTE annually, about 36.5% of the supplied role-time baseline. Applying the individual human-time estimates gives a gross 386 hours per FTE, or about 1,158 hours and EUR 52,100 of capacity across three FTE annually at EUR 45/hour, before overlap, implementation, support and new review work. Intake, coding, checking and reconciliation overlap, so these are not additive realised savings or a headcount forecast. Current workflows and work anatomy are inferred; time_saved_pct estimates active human effort, while speedup estimates elapsed task completion including automated processing and ordinary review waits. Payment authority, accounting-policy judgements, disputes and customer relationships remain limiting factors.
skills_to_grow: AFAS import, connector and bank-matching configuration, including permissions and failure recovery
Reconciliation design, duplicate prevention and source completeness checks
Maintaining approved coding, calculation and agency-rate rules with effective dates
Reviewing model suggestions against source evidence and recognising unsupported answers
Exception analysis and clear explanations for site managers, suppliers and customers
Measuring handling time, elapsed time, escaped errors and control overrides

Applying AVG/GDPR data minimisation and access controls, especially because AFAS also contains HR records; the AP explains these principles in its [OR privacy guide](https://www.autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl/uploads/imported/ap_or_privacy-boekje.pdf)

Working with HR and the OR when proposed changes affect employee-data processing or monitoring; keep CAO interpretations and Wet verbetering poortwachter absence casework with the responsible HR specialists
role.ambitious_version: Run a daily finance readiness process across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo that identifies missing costs, unmatched cash, coding uncertainty and payment exceptions before they delay close. Give the Controller and FP&A timestamped, reconciled evidence for cash and forecast assumptions, and improve the source processes causing repeat errors. Start with native AFAS functions and deterministic controls, adding models for document interpretation and drafted explanations where pilots prove value. Keep any extension into worker evaluation or employment decisions subject to a separate assessment: the European Commission identifies those uses as potentially high risk under the [EU AI Act](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/recital-57).
